services.name: Day Tour with illumination lights and Fireworks Option added
services.desc: Join us! Part 1 during the day approx. 4-5 hr Part 2 at night approx. 15 to 20 minutes illumination light About Enjoy our USA side tour including the Maid of the Mist, Cave of the Winds, Niagara Observation Tower, and much more. Our professional tour guide will show you terrific views of Niagara Falls as well as provide you with interesting facts and stories about the Falls and its history. After your tour during the day is complete we take you back to your hotel. At 6:30PM we will pick you up again and take you to Niagara Falls State Park to see the evening Illumination light Pickup and Drop off in Niagara Falls USA only

services.name: Autumn/Spring Tour with Winery Option
services.desc: Enjoy Niagara Falls in the Winter and Spring season on this all-inclusive tour. You will experience the gorge walk at the Cave of the Winds as well as majestic views of the Falls from many different perspectives. Enjoy a complimentary hot drink and cookie at one of the area's most popular bakeries. Conclude your tour with a visit to historic Lewiston and a tasting at a local winery. Note: The boat is closed for the season and not included on this tour. 4-5 hours Includes: 1.CAVE OF THE WINDS (Gorge Walk) 2.TERRAPIN POINT 3.NIAGARA STATE PARK 4.GOAT ISLAND 5.AMERICAN FALLS 6.LUNA 5 Hours • Hotel Pick Up • Off Season Tour

services.name: Niagara Falls Canada Evening Tour
services.desc: Make unforgettable memories on this hassle-free once in a lifetime experience as you see the best of that Niagara Falls, Canada has to offer. Your experienced tour guide will lead you around all of the many sites of Canada as you explore the tunnels at the magnificent Journey Behind the Falls, and ride to the top of the soaring Skylon Tower to see the majestic Falls from above. Cap off the evening with the spectacular Illumination Light Show and Fireworks. 5-6 hours Includes: Illumination Light Show Fireworks at Falls (Seasonal) Journey Behind the Falls Clifton Hill Floral Clock 5 Hours • Hotel Pickup/Dropoff Niagara Falls Downtown only

services.name: Niagara Falls USA & Canada Combo Tour with Boat Ride
services.desc: Ride aboard the World Famous Niagara City Boat Cruise and get up close to the roaring majestic Falls at the Cave of the Winds Gorge Walk! Along with this Wonder of the world come and see the beautiful sights that Niagara Falls Canada has to offer. 6-7 hours Includes: Boat Ride Cave of the Winds Gorge Walk Clifton Hill (Scenic View) Horseshoe Falls American falls Skylon Tower Whirlpool Table Rock Floral Clock Lower Rapids What's included Best of Niagara Falls: All attractions included Best Tour Company: Expert, Local and Professional tour guides Complimentary: Free bottled water Tour 6-7 Hours only pick up USA Side

services.name: Private Walking Tour with Boat Cave and Trolley
services.desc: Guided tour and shuttle transportation for a group of 75 guests. Includes Three buses with drivers/guides picking up at the Doubletree Hotel in Niagara Falls, NY. Guests will be taken to the Maid of the Mist boat where they will ride the cruise and view the Falls from the Niagara Observation Tower. Guests will then visit Goat Island to view Niagara Falls from Terrapin Point and Luna Island. Group will be taken to the Hard Rock Cafe for dinner at 5:30. After dinner, guests will be taken back to the Doubletree by 9:00 Private Niagara Falls USA Tour

quotes.author: ANGELA M
quotes.text: Fun trip to the Falls We had a wonderful experience with our guide Mark. I loved the American side! It was situated in a beautiful state park rather than the casino and hotel side of Canada. The best part was Maid of the Mist…. Thank goodness we had ponchos. The tour was very well planned and organized and educational as far as Buffalo history. I would definitely recommend and it was nice not having to worry about navigating the tours and parking on our own.

quotes.author: lsolis2399 Email
quotes.text: Excellent tour! Our bus driver and tour guide was Serena. She was knowledgeable and funny. We would talk to her once we are off the bus and got the scoop on place to go and additional history of the area. The tour was about 3 1/2 hours and worth every minute. We went to Niagara State Park, Made of the Mist, Cave of the Winds and Di'Camillo Bakery. Great experience!

quotes.author: Zara S
quotes.text: Travel once and you'll never forget Ready to feel the power of Niagara Falls up close? 🌊 This all-inclusive USA tour covers everything, the legendary boat ride, Cave of the Winds, and tons more adventures packed into one epic day! Kinda like the caffeine rush I get from dutchbrosmenudrink.com both guaranteed to wake you up!

quotes.author: Regina Peel
quotes.text: Gary and Jimmy made everything easy so we were able to enjoy the day that much more! Gary made all the arrangements: we spent a fabulous day between the US and Canada. Jimmy knew all the best places and added to the experience by giving us loads of historical information. Great trip!

This tour made our 4 day stay marvelous! We chose the 7 person in Mercedes Van Tour with Jimmy Coyte as our talented and expert guide. It was a class A experience with a Class A Guide. Thanks SO Much to Jimmy and the fellow who sold us the package!!!

quotes.author: PixelEthan i
quotes.text: Very happy with the experience Our tour guide Christine at Niagara Falls was excellent. She was knowledgeable, organized, and kept the group engaged throughout the tour. I would gladly recommend them to anyone visiting the area.
